entries.label: Conspicuous Feasts
entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One original opaque full-bleed medieval dark-fantasy game card illustration, fresh composition. Narrative composition in the spirit of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action or building, bold silhouettes, grouped anonymous figures, monumental environmental scale, broad calm value masses, one focal area of strongest light and contrast. Hand-placed pixel clusters, hard edges, selective dithering and a strictly restricted palette, matching only the surface treatment in the two attached references (do not reproduce their eyes, portals, writing or scenes). All living AND dead human faces and faces on statues must be entirely indiscernible at full size: backs, completely closed helmets, completely dark hoods, covered shrouds, skulls turned away with no eye sockets or jaw detail. No readable eyes, noses or mouths. Oppressive functioning remnant empire, with systemic neglect clearly visible, not a flourishing player institution. Avoid glamorous clean luxury. Non-graphic old remains, burial shrouds, rot and despair, no exposed wounds or gore. Readable as simple shapes at 70x100. Illustration only: no text, legible writing, symbols, UI, frame, border, vignette, or tiny distracting clutter. 5:7 portrait Practice: all principal figures, action and identifying banquet food in upper central 45%; lower half subdued quiet broad shadow masses for overlays. Palette: dominant saturated deep malachite / bottle green across the great drapes, enamel and architecture, with a strong secondary oxidized copper ORANGE. Near-black green shadows and small cold stone highlights. Green and orange must read immediately in a tiny thumbnail. No dominant gold, yellow, ivory, blue, purple or red palette. Subject: viewed slightly from above, two back-facing massively cloaked green-robed oligarchs on a raised copper-orange banquet dais pour an entire tray of still recognisable food into a refuse chute. Beneath the dais, a chained shut serving grille separates a small queue of bent shrouded starving adults from the food; nearby a low cart of completely wrapped adult corpses and a few back-facing ribcage remains lie abandoned in mould and stagnant water. Place this relationship in the upper half, starkly clear. Background vast cracked counting-palace hall with mould-stained green hangings. Human misery is central to the action, not decorative skull motifs.

entries.label: Enemy institution frame
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: single transparent illustrated game card picture RIM, adapted from the provided existing structure frame. Preserve the original front-on upright 3:4 rectangular aperture and outer footprint, corner framing and symmetrical stretchable straight sides. Replace the polished brass/fleur-de-lis decoration with a decaying imperial enemy institution rim: BLACKENED IRON rails, large ASH-BONE corner clasps shaped as simple inward hooks like broken ribs, short rusted chains fused into each long side, a few chipped teeth in the rim. Oppressive, funerary, rough and corroded, unmistakably different silhouette from clean brass player frame. Pale bone corners against black iron must read at thumbnail size, keep rails thin and aperture large. Broad top centre remains an unobtrusive straight rail (no badge); upper-left can later hold a separate allegiance marker. Nine-slice-compatible: all distinctive ornament confined to four corners, long central edge segments plain and repeatable. Old-school dark fantasy hand-placed pixel clusters, hard edges, selective dithering, restricted charcoal/ashbone/rust palette. TRUE alpha transparent central aperture AND outside rectangle, no black or grey background pixels in aperture, no checkerboard. No artwork, figures, faces, portraits, symbols, letters, numbers, writing, UI or stock/counter slots. Image is only ONE complete front-on rectangular rim with transparent hole. Do not make a sheet or variants.
